bio: Research Background Contact Us Carter Petty is a senior biostatistician in the Biostatistics and Research Design (BARD) Center . Carter is an applied biostatistician who collaborates with clinicians and scientists in clinical, epidemiological, and basic science research. He earned a master's degree in statistics from Harvard University in 2002. Carter has co-authored over 100 peer-reviewed publications in a variety of research areas, including psychiatry and psychology, pediatric asthma and allergy, and quality measurement.
